description: Your messages in a chat (Baude's, Record's, Meta's): revert and queued messages' buttons, and the prompt a session was started with.

messages.revert: Revert: take back this message and everything after it, and put it back in the box
messages.queued_send_now: Send now: send this and the queued messages before it, without stopping the chat
messages.queued_edit: Edit: put this message back in the box
